name: Hating Your Parents
overview: Scripture clearly commands honoring and respecting parents, emphasizing the blessing of long life as a result of obedience to this command (Exodus 20:12). Disregarding or despising one's parents is strongly condemned, with warnings of curses upon those who treat their father or mother lightly (Deuteronomy 27:16) and descriptions of foolishness linked to despising one's mother (Proverbs 15:20). The Lord’s jealousy and justice extend to punishing the consequences of hatred toward Him, which can include familial rebellion (Exodus 20:5). Wisdom and godly instruction begin in the home, as children are urged to heed their parents' guidance and training (Proverbs 1:8; 22:6), underscoring the vital role of honoring parents in a Christ-centered life.
